title: Polynomial-time circuit satisfiability transformation
statement: There exist a deterministic Turing machine with a finite state set and natural numbers $C,c$ such that, on every finite bit string $w$, it halts within $C(|w|+1)^c$ steps and outputs the following transformation: decode $w$ as a directed acyclic Boolean circuit; if decoding succeeds and the circuit is well formed with every gate reading at most two arguments, output the binary serialization of its Tseitin conjunctive normal form with the output vertex required to be true; otherwise output the serialization of the CNF consisting of one empty clause.
hypotheses_covered: Input is any finite bit string
There exist natural-number constants $C$ and $c$ giving a polynomial time bound
The computing Turing machine has a finite state set
